task1_realestate_com_au_api.summary: realestate.com.au is a Next.js / React app served via a custom SSR framework called Argonaut (CDN: argonaut.au.reastatic.net). Listing search data is NOT in __NEXT_DATA__ but in window.ArgonautExchange. The search backend is a GraphQL endpoint at lexa.realestate.com.au.

architecture.analytics: New Relic (bam.nr-data.net), Adobe Analytics (smetrics), Google Analytics GA4 (G-3J0XCBB972)
architecture.monitoring: Qualtrics site intercept, Tealium tag manager (reagroupdata.com.au)

window_ArgonautExchange_structure.note: HAR captured homepage only; homepage ArgonautExchange contains news articles and homepage components, NOT search listings. Search results page would populate a different key.

homepage_subkeys.NEWS_ARTICLES: array of { title, author.name, readDuration, href, excerpt, publishedTime, fields.postThumb.href, __typename }

confirmed_search_parameters.locations: array of strings e.g. ['Chelsea Heights, 3196', 'Sydney, NSW']

listing_response_fields.listers: array of { id, name, photo, phoneNumbers }

homeloans_graphql_schema_sample.query_signature: query GetBrokers($postcode: String!) { brokers { search(postcode: $postcode) { brokers { franchise { id, code }, firstName, lastName, suburb, profilePhotoURL, profileURL, franchiseStaffId } } } }

task2_domain_com_au_api.summary: domain.com.au is a standard Next.js app. Property data is embedded in __NEXT_DATA__ script tag. Domain also exposes an official developer API at developer.domain.com.au (OAuth2/Bearer auth) and a public GraphQL-style endpoint used internally.

listing.agents: array of { id, name, photo, phone, email }
listing.headline: string
listing.nearbySchools: array of { name, educationLevel, gender, url }

request_body.locations: array of { state, suburb, postCode, region, area }

task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.name: Soho
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.funding_status: Series B; raised A$5M+ to date; led by Feedback Ventures (Singapore); valued ~$20M
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.unique_feature: PropertyMatch AI engine — swipe-based UX that learns buyer/renter preferences; ranks 400,000+ listings by match quality NOT paid placement. Unlike REA/Domain, agents cannot buy top placement.
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.target_market: Property buyers and renters (B2C); real estate agents seeking organic match exposure
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.differentiator_vs_big_two: Anti-paid-placement model; AI preference learning; Sotheby's International Realty integration

task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.name: view.com.au (View Media Group)
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.funding_status: Founded Aug 2022 by ex-Domain CEO Antony Catalano and 6 ex-Domain execs. Private; no public funding rounds found. Revenue-funded via freemium agent listings model.
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.unique_feature: Freemium listing model (free for agents), Nearmap high-resolution aerial maps, unlisted/off-market property expressions of interest, built-in automated valuation/price estimator
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.target_market: Property buyers, renters, and sellers (B2C); agents (B2B freemium disruptor vs REA/Domain subscription fees)
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.differentiator_vs_big_two: Free to list; fastest-growing portal in AU (+102% unique audience YoY per IPSOS Feb 2024); off-market inventory
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.status: Active, Australia's #3 fastest-growing portal as of 2024

task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.name: Coposit
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.funding_status: Seed: A$14M oversubscribed (40% over target); corporate advisory Ad Astra. Founded 2021 by brothers Chris & Dan Ferris. CBA and other lenders as commercial partners.
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.unique_feature: Buy off-the-plan new property with $10,000 minimum deposit, pay balance via weekly interest-free installments during construction period. Not a lender — fee charged to developer only, zero cost to buyer.
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.target_market: First-home buyers and affordability-constrained buyers of new/off-the-plan properties; property developers needing pre-sales
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.differentiator_vs_big_two: Not a search portal — a transaction/financing layer. Solves deposit gap for buyers. Integrated with CBA and multiple lenders.

task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.name: FOUNDIT
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.funding_status: Pre-seed: A$2M (June 2025). Investors include leaders from Realbase, Realtair, Propps. Co-founded by Angus Ferguson (ex-Domain exec) and Joel Tomaino (ex-Frazis Capital).
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.unique_feature: Hybrid buyers-agent + tech platform: pairs each buyer with a local expert buyers agent, provides exclusive off-market listings, AI-powered market research, and aims to reduce average buy timeline by 50%. Targets growing buyers-agent segment (8% → 25% of transactions).
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.target_market: Property buyers who want professional buyers-agent support; property investors. B2C Sydney-first, expanding nationally.
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.differentiator_vs_big_two: Service + tech hybrid (not just listings); off-market access; professional guidance embedded in platform; no advertising-based revenue model
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.status: Launched June 2025, Sydney first, national expansion underway

task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.name: Agentsy
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.funding_status: Pre-seed: A$700K (Feb 2026). Nationwide rollout from closed beta.
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.unique_feature: AI-native back-office platform for real estate agencies: automates email responses, compliance communications, marketing collateral, and workflow tasks. Productivity tool, not a consumer listing portal.
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.target_market: Real estate agencies and agents (B2B SaaS); not a consumer-facing portal
task3_unknown_au_proptech_competitors.differentiator_vs_big_two: Not competing for listings eyeballs — competing for agent operational time and agency software spend (vs PropertyMe, Console, etc.)

competitive_landscape_notes.dominant_duopoly: realestate.com.au (REA Group / News Corp) + domain.com.au (Nine Entertainment) control ~90%+ of AU property search traffic and charge agents premium subscription + boost fees
disruption_vectors_observed: Freemium listing model to undercut REA/Domain fees (view.com.au)
competitive_landscape_notes.market_size: AU PropTech market valued ~USD 5B (Oct 2025); 350+ active firms
competitive_landscape_notes.key_trend: Housing affordability crisis driving product innovation around deposit solutions, buyers-agent adoption, and AI personalization
